description: Scores from the Digital Gemology Cut Performance Index for every cut we sell: overall, brilliance, fire, scintillation, tilt, symmetry, spread, shape-norm and leakage, ray traced separately in diamond, moissanite, cubic zirconia, ruby, sapphire, emerald and amethyst, with each cut's place in its material. Filter by cut, category or material; with no filter, every row. Figures are unrounded. Never compare or rank scores across materials. Ruby and sapphire share one refractive index, so the same figures. Cuts not yet scored come with the reason.

category.description: brilliants, jewelry, historic, house or platonic.

cut.description: The cut's slug or name, for example 'oval' or 'DG-M5'.

material.description: One stone (diamond, moissanite, cubic-zirconia, ruby, sapphire, emerald or amethyst); leave it out for all seven.

name: get_cut_scores
title: Cut Performance Index scores
